raw_fields.Description:
Mission: We are committed to the professional success of our partners and our team members. Through our devotion to quality craftsmanship, we strive to provide trusted software development solutions for our partners.

First Factory is home to a team of more than 200 talented Costa Rican software engineers who are passionate about the work provided to our clients. Our NY-based operation is where we handle all client relations, while our team of remote employees within the US manages other corporate operations. We work with clients in commerce, education, finance, fintech, healthcare, human services, logistics & transportation, real estate and more across the globe, and have experience with even the most complex technologies. We are committed to fulfilling the development needs of our clients and ensuring professional growth and cultivation for our employees.

As part of our initiative to become the most developer-friendly workplace in Costa Rica, we are proud to offer the following for employees in our Heredia, Costa Rica office:

* Competitive salary and all benefits
* Centrally-located office with free parking
* Work from home eligibility
* Free breakfast or lunch once per week
* The top tools to make sure you can do your best
* Regular team-building outings to enjoy a better work-life balance 
* Comfortable, open work environment (no cubicles) with no dress code
* Long term career growth potential 

Feel free to check out our current openings: https://firstfactory.com/open-positions/

If you’d prefer to email your CV or have a question for our recruitment team, please send an email to jobs@firstfactory.com, and we will be in touch shortly.

When I Work is the market leader in shift-based workforce management software and delivers a powerful, employee-first experience. With an all-in-one platform that includes employee scheduling, time tracking, and communication, we make it easy for small businesses to run their locations. Over 200,000 shift-based workplaces rely on When I Work to develop happier, more productive teams.
